rule: A value is OPEN until P01 approves it; an approved value carries `approved` and its `approval_record`. `proposed` is a proposal for P01 review, never an approved or production value. Fixture values are test inputs, not recommendations.

tiers.decide: Economic, governance and security choices P01 makes.
tiers.operate: Operational settings with an engineering default; P01 confirms.
tiers.measure: Set from measurements on dedicated staging hosts (E03, T02, T05).
tiers.derived: Fixed by an approved rule or another value; the genesis builder sets them.

values.name: app_max_tx_bytes
values.couplings: emergency/upgrade/handover max_control_bytes <= max_tx_bytes (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/consensus_settlement.rs:239-243, 257-261, 292-296); ordinary.max_transport_bytes <= max_tx_bytes (:345-349). The Go fixture sets engine mempool.max_tx_bytes to the same constant (node/consensus/cometbft/cmd/dytallix-comet-fixture/main.go:37-38,232) but no code compares the engine and application values.
values.notes: Fixture value only, not a recommendation.

values.name: app_max_block_bytes
values.type_unit: usize, bytes of transactions per block
values.couplings: Block byte check (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/consensus_settlement.rs:2608); proposal limit is min(engine max tx bytes, max_block_bytes) (:3704-3706); issuance utilization capacity = epoch_blocks x max_block_bytes (:2555-2557). Not compared with engine consensus_params.block.max_bytes.
values.notes: Fixture value only, not a recommendation.

values.name: app_pinned_gas_price
values.notes: No reader outside validate() was found in node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src (grep for gas_price). Charged prices come from the ordinary and recovery fee profiles. Possibly vestigial; confirm before choosing a value. Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: Equals the ordinary gas price.

values.name: app_validator_power
values.type_unit: i64, voting power (= bonded uDGT under lifecycle)
values.code_bounds: each > 0; sum <= i64::MAX/8; under lifecycle must equal effective bonded stake and self-bond >= min_self_bond
values.couplings: Derived from reward_v2 positions; engine genesis validator power must match (bridge passes req.Validators).
values.notes: Not an independent choice: listed for completeness because allocations determine it. Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: Equals each genesis validator's bonded stake under the lifecycle profile.

values.name: min_self_bond
values.couplings: Genesis validators' self-bond must be >= min_self_bond (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/consensus_settlement.rs:1878-1881). Governed within governance.parameter_bounds.min_self_bond (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/governance_actions.rs:89-93), but the genesis value is not checked against those bounds. Excluded from the validator proof profile digest (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/ordinary_state.rs:84-89).
values.notes: Go fixture additionally requires >= 10 uDGT self-bond (fixture-only rule, node/consensus/cometbft/cmd/dytallix-comet-fixture/lifecycle.go:88-91). Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: 100,000 DGT: 0.01% of supply and 10 times the governance deposit; the 5% penalty costs at least 5,000 DGT.

values.name: max_active
values.couplings: Must be <= reward_v2.max_validators (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/runtime/validator_lifecycle.rs:733-737; node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/governance_actions.rs:254-256). Engine genesis allows at most 64 validators (node/consensus/cometbft/internal/enginepqc/engine.go:332). Governed within parameter_bounds.max_active (max <= 64); genesis value not checked against the bounds.
values.notes: Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: Room above a launch set of four to seven validators; governance can change it within its bounds.

values.name: evidence_max_age_blocks
values.couplings: Must equal engine consensus_params.evidence.max_age_num_blocks at InitChain (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/bin/consensus_stdio.rs:206-222; node/consensus/cometbft/cmd/dytallix-comet-bridge/application.go:132-137); the Go fixture copies it (node/consensus/cometbft/cmd/dytallix-comet-fixture/main.go:274-276). Evidence expires only when both block and time ages are exceeded (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/consensus_settlement.rs:2716-2726; same rule upstream node/consensus/cometbft/upstream/evidence/pool.go:273-274). Sets unbond maturity and record retention horizon with the margins (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/runtime/validator_lifecycle.rs:100-110). Not governed (:87-96).
values.notes: Docs: evidence limits also set the unbonding period and retention horizon (node/docs/mainnet/e04-requirement-triage.md:96). Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: 14 days at the proposed 5 s interval; both limits must pass for maturity.

values.name: evidence_max_age_seconds
values.couplings: Must equal engine consensus_params.evidence.max_age_duration exactly, with zero sub-second remainder (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/bin/consensus_stdio.rs:206-222). Engine state-sync trust_period must be below this duration (node/consensus/cometbft/cmd/dytallix-pqc-engine/main.go:54-57).
values.notes: Values above about 9.2e9 s cannot be represented as a Go time.Duration; the InitChain equality check would then fail closed. Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: 14 days: evidence stays admissible for two weeks, so unbonded stake matures after about 14 days plus the margin.

values.notes: Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: One hour at 5 s blocks.

values.name: processing_margin_seconds

values.name: penalty_numerator
values.type_unit: u64, ratio numerator (share of bonded stake)
values.code_bounds: > 0 and <= penalty_denominator; production_activation must be false
values.couplings: Ratio numerator/denominator is the penalty rate applied once to all stake bonded to the validator at the evidence height (node/docs/architecture/penalties-v1.md:14-20).
values.notes: Ratio of exactly 1 (100%) is accepted. Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: With a denominator of 20: a 5% penalty for a first double-sign, a common rate on CometBFT chains. The register asks that the synthetic 1/20 not be promoted without review; this is that review's proposal.

values.name: ordinary_gas_price
values.couplings: Charge = max(gas_used, minimum_gas) x gas_price (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/ordinary_fee_settlement.rs:356). Signed request needs gas_limit x gas_price <= maximum_fee <= max_fee_cap (node/crates/protocol-types/src/ordinary_fees.rs:126-138). Governed: governance may change it within parameter_bounds (node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/ordinary_state.rs:59-75; node/dytallix-fast-launch/node/src/governance_actions.rs:78-87). Because max_fee_cap is ungoverned, a governed gas_price above max_fee_cap / max_transaction_gas lowers the usable gas limit; no check ties parameter_bounds.gas_price.max to max_fee_cap.
values.notes: Fixture value only, not a recommendation.
values.basis: Gas price 10 times minimum gas 100,000 is the 1 DRT transfer.
